parameters.name: NetworkAware
parameters.description: Indicates that the device is capable of maintaining a network connection and responding to communications via the network connection while in a standby state.

parameters.name: TimerAware
parameters.description: Indicates that the device is capable of maintaining and responding to timers while in a standby state.
